name: RSI EA v2
summary: This EA trades based on RSI overbought and oversold levels, entering buy positions when RSI crosses below the oversold threshold and sell positions when RSI crosses above the overbought threshold. It uses configurable RSI period and threshold parameters with optional take-profit and stop-loss levels. The strategy is a classic mean-reversion approach using the RSI momentum oscillator.
summary_zh: 该EA基于RSI超买超卖水平进行交易，当RSI下穿超卖阈值时买入，当RSI上穿超买阈值时卖出。它使用可配置的RSI周期和阈值参数，并设有可选的止盈和止损水平。该策略是基于RSI动量振荡器的经典均值回归方法。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用RSI（相对强弱指数）作为核心指标，通过设定超买和超卖阈值来识别市场的极端状态。入场条件为：当RSI从超卖区域上穿时开多单，当RSI从超买区域下穿时开空单，这是一种典型的均值回归策略思路。出场条件依赖预设的止盈和止损水平，若未设置则持仓至反向信号出现。仓位管理方面，默认使用固定手数交易，未集成动态仓位调整或资金管理模块。资金管理较为简单，缺乏基于账户余额或风险百分比的自动计算逻辑。整体策略逻辑直观但缺少多重确认机制和趋势过滤器，容易在强趋势行情中产生连续逆势亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the RSI (Relative Strength Index) as its core indicator, identifying extreme market conditions through overbought and oversold thresholds. Entry conditions are: open a buy when RSI crosses up from oversold territory, and open a sell when RSI crosses down from overbought territory, which is a classic mean-reversion approach. Exit conditions rely on preset take-profit and stop-loss levels, or positions may remain open until a reverse signal appears if TP/SL are not configured. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size by default without dynamic adjustment or integrated money management modules. Money management is relatively simplistic, lacking automatic lot calculation based on account balance or risk percentage. The overall strategy logic is straightforward but lacks multi-confirmation mechanisms and trend filters, making it prone to consecutive counter-trend losses during strong trending markets.

parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: Take Profit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调试
RSI是经过长期验证的经典动量指标，信号可靠性较高
参数可配置性强，用户可根据不同品种和市场环境灵活调整超买超卖阈值
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and debug
RSI is a well-tested classic momentum indicator with relatively reliable signals
High configurability allows users to flexibly adjust overbought/oversold thresholds for different instruments and market conditions
cons: 缺乏趋势过滤器，在强趋势行情中容易频繁逆势开仓导致连续亏损
没有动态仓位管理，固定手数无法适应不同账户规模和波动环境
止盈止损默认为0，若用户忘记设置则面临无限风险敞口
缺少多重确认机制，仅依赖单一RSI指标容易产生虚假信号
cons_en: Lacks a trend filter, prone to frequent counter-trend entries during strong trending markets leading to consecutive losses
No dynamic position sizing, fixed lot size cannot adapt to different account sizes and volatility environments
Default TP/SL of 0 exposes unlimited risk if users forget to set them
Lacks multi-confirmation mechanism, relying solely on RSI容易 produces false signals
improvements: 添加趋势过滤器（如EMA或ADX），仅在顺趋势方向交易RSI信号
集成基于账户风险百分比的资金管理模块，自动计算最优手数
增加多重确认机制，如结合MACD或布林带过滤虚假RSI信号
添加新K线检测防止同一根K线内多次开仓
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., EMA or ADX) to only trade RSI signals in the trend direction
Integrate a money management module based on account risk percentage to auto-calculate optimal lot size
Add multi-confirmation mechanisms such as combining MACD or Bollinger Bands to filter false RSI signals
Add new bar detection to prevent multiple entries within the same candle

risk_points: 止盈止损默认值为0，若未手动设置则持仓无保护
缺乏趋势过滤器在单边行情中可能产生连续逆势亏损
固定手数未根据账户规模和波动率动态调整
risk_points_en: Default TP/SL of 0 means positions are unprotected if not manually set
Lack of trend filter can produce consecutive counter-trend losses in trending markets
Fixed lot size does not dynamically adjust based on account size and volatility
